messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Thank you, John. I found your account. Your line 555-123-2002 (L1002) is Active and has roaming enabled (though you're not roaming). Since you can make calls and use mobile data, let's focus on MMS-specific issues.

First, let's check your APN settings, as incorrect APN (especially the MMSC URL) is a common cause of MMS failures.

Please run this on your phone:
- **check_apn_settings**

Let me know what it shows (APN name and MMSC URL).

The current APN name is "internet" and the MMSC URL for picture messages is set to "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc". What should I do next?

Please complete the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
